newsitem.title: USA: Microwave Power wins $12 mln foreign military deal.
newsitem.headline: Microwave Power wins $12 mln foreign military deal.

text.p: Microwave Power Devices Inc said Tuesday it had been awarded a $12.0-million foreign military contract for amplifiers.
Microwave said in a statement the contract became effective immediately with shipments scheduled to begin during the first quarter of 1999.
"With the receipt of this contract, our backlog totals approximately $94 million, a record level for the Company," it said.
Microwave did not elaborate and a spokesman for the company declined to provide further information about the client.
Microwave Power Devices makes power amplifiers and related subsystems for the wireless telecommunications market.
The amplifiers, which are a key component in cellular base stations, increase the power of radio frequency and microwave signals with low distortion.
